# POI symbols

Copied unchanged from the Fußgängeratlas Stuttgart (`Styling/SVG`, 27 October 2026). Newly drawn geometric symbols by Mohammadreza Bakhshi, released under CC0 1.0 Universal: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ . `scripts/embed_poi_icons.py` bundles them into `dist/poi-icons.json`.
